name: security
description: Server protection suite: anti-nuke, join gate, verification, panic mode, backups, and automod

antinuke.name: security-antinuke
antinuke.description: Anti-nuke detection with sliding windows, quarantine/ban responses, and trusted role exemptions

join-gate.name: security-join-gate
join-gate.description: On-join security filters: no avatar, min age, unverified bots, advertising names, suspicious accounts, username patterns, and raid detection

verification.name: security-verification
verification.description: Member verification with emoji captcha, web verification, pending/verified roles, and timeout sweep

panic.name: security-panic
panic.description: Automated server lockdown on threat velocity spikes, channel locking, invite disabling, and permission snapshots

backups.name: security-backups
backups.description: Periodic server structure snapshots (roles, channels, permissions) for auto-recovery and manual restore

betrayal.name: security-betrayal
betrayal.description: Velocity monitoring of whitelisted users with per-action minute/hour limits and automatic immunity revocation

autorecovery.name: security-autorecovery
autorecovery.description: Automatic server restore from latest backup when panic mode triggers or nuke detected

automod.name: security-automod
automod.description: Heat-based automod with 13 filters, escalating punishments, heat panic mode, and permit-based immunity

configFields.label: Security Log Channel
configFields.description: Channel for security logs (anti-nuke, join gate, verification, panic, betrayal)

configFields.label: Quarantine Role
configFields.description: Role assigned to quarantined members (required for anti-nuke, join gate, verification)

configFields.label: Trusted Roles
configFields.description: Role IDs exempt from anti-nuke and join gate filters

configFields.label: Min Account Age (hours)
configFields.description: Accounts younger than this are flagged by join gate (0 disables)
